stem: Which statement best describes the boundary of Technician II peer support?
choices: Technician II may coach task execution, verify understanding, provide structured handoffs, and escalate recurring gaps, but formal discipline, staffing decisions, and supervisor sign-off remain outside the role unless separately authorized
Technician II becomes the supervisor whenever a peer asks a question
Technician II may change controlled procedures during coaching
Technician II has no responsibility for peer task quality
rationale: The role includes experienced peer support and task-level coordination while preserving formal supervisory, disciplinary, and procedure-ownership boundaries.
